verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a payments API platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents API credentials, roles, permissions or scoping for Adyen In-Person Payments. The MCP server and Management API items describe agent access and terminal automation, not least-privilege credential issuance, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
